# SPECTRA design program: NMOS cascode CS + PMOS current-source load
# Changes vs. previous iteration:
#  - stiffer cascode gate divider (lower Rdiv) so the gate is not pulled by
#    the stack current, and the divider is counted in power
#  - PMOS load and its diode share the same Vsd target, so the mirror ratio is
#    set by W alone (no Vds mismatch)
#  - M1 sized at its actual Vds target (vx_t) with a Vdsat margin check
#  - mirror current kb kept small to hold the 76 uW budget

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (11, 9, 13),           # signal NMOS gm/Id
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),       # signal NMOS length
    "I1":    (20e-6, 16e-6, 24e-6), # stage current
    "kb":    (0.25, 0.15, 0.4),     # mirror-branch current as fraction of I1
    "gmid2": (6, 4.5, 7),           # PMOS load gm/Id
    "L2":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),       # PMOS load length
    "gmidc": (12, 9, 14),           # cascode NMOS gm/Id
    "Lc":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # cascode NMOS length
    "Rdiv":  (0.8e6, 0.4e6, 1.5e6), # cascode-bias divider total resistance
    "vx_t":  (0.30, 0.25, 0.35),    # DC voltage of cascode source node
}

VDD = 1.8
GM_MIR = 10.0
L_MIR = 1.0
VOUT_T = 0.9    # target output DC level used for device sizing


def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    CL = spec["cl"]
    I1 = p["I1"]
    I_b = p["kb"] * I1
    vx_t = p["vx_t"]
    rdiv = p["Rdiv"]

    # ---- NMOS bias chain: same gm/Id and L, currents scale with W ----
    mr = lut.size("n", GM_MIR, L_MIR, iref, vds=0.6)
    mnb = lut.size("n", GM_MIR, L_MIR, I_b, vds=0.6)

    # ---- PMOS load (I1) and diode mirror (I_b): identical Vsd target ----
    vsd_p = VDD - VOUT_T
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], I1, vds=vsd_p)
    mpb = lut.size("p", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], I_b, vds=vsd_p)

    # ---- NMOS cascode: source at vx_t, gate at vx_t + Vgs3 ----
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], I1, vds=VOUT_T - vx_t, vsb=vx_t)
    vc = vx_t + m3.vgs
    vc = min(max(vc, 0.6), VDD - 0.3)
    rb2 = rdiv * vc / VDD
    rb1 = rdiv - rb2

    # ---- signal device: drain is node x at vx_t ----
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=vx_t)

    # ---- netlist ----
    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "vout", "vc", "x", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.dev("Mpb", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpb)
    n.dev("Mnb", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnb)
    n.dev("Mr", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    n.R("Rb1", "vdd", "vc", rb1)
    n.R("Rb2", "vc", "vss", rb2)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    ro1 = 1.0 / m1.gds
    rcas = m3.intrinsic_gain * ro1
    ro2 = m2.intrinsic_gain / m2.gm
    rout = 1.0 / (1.0 / ro2 + 1.0 / rcas)

    gain_lin = gm1 * rout
    gain_db = db(gain_lin)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * CL)
    f3db = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rout * CL)

    # total supply current: iref + I1 (M2) + I_b (Mpb) + divider
    power = VDD * (iref + I1 + I_b + VDD / rdiv)

    # output window: bottom = cascode saturation edge, top = PMOS load saturation edge
    vlow = vx_t + m3.vdsat
    vhigh = VDD - m2.vdsat
    vout_dc = 0.5 * (vlow + vhigh)
    swing = 2.0 * min(vout_dc - vlow, vhigh - vout_dc)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": gain_db,
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout_dc,
        "swing": swing,
    }
